summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K containing a news release announcing results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including the election of directors, approval of independent auditors, auditor pay, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. The filing also notes the departure of two directors and the addition of Patrick Godin to the board. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event is described; it is a routine foreign private issuer report of meeting outcomes. No deal terms are present.
